_comment: Maps the legacy microsoft/TypeScript corpus SHA to the exact npm compiler paired with it. TypeScript 7 compiler sources live in microsoft/typescript-go; native_* records that side of the pairing.
_usage: For TypeScript 7+, use the microsoft/typescript-go release tag and its _submodules/TypeScript SHA. Keep npm, native_tag, native_sha, and the mapping key in lockstep.
